allow: PowerShell($response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output "Status: $\($response.StatusCode\)"; $response.Content | Select-String -Pattern "Score your CV|CVPilot|Three steps|Simple pricing" | Select-Object -First 5 | ForEach-Object { "Found: $_" })

PowerShell($r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:3000" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; "Status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $r.Content | Select-String -Pattern "Score your CV|CVPilot|Three steps|Simple pricing|No credit" | ForEach-Object Line | Select-Object -First 8)
